d:
The Mavericks defeated the Jazz, 112-100 tonight in Dallas. P.J. Washington finished with a team-high 26 points along with 6 rebounds and 6 three pointers for the Mavericks, while Cooper Flagg tallied 21 points, 10 rebounds and 7 assists in the game. Lauri Markkanen recorded 24 points, 8 rebounds and 8 three pointers. The Mavericks improve their record to 5-4 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-8 for the season.
